items.title: William "Big Bill" Thompson Interview, 1961-03-01
items.q: Frank had quit, like Bruce, he said. You heard Bruce, but Bruce had...

ctx.x: I don't... I don't think it's that long, but if you think... Yeah, it's that long. Because I played... I played with Frank... with Frank and Bill already. And I mean... Yeah, but... I mean, I was a young kid, around 12, 13 years old. I know that. But, uh... I don't know... 40 years old. I might be. But 40 years would be about 1920.

Frank... Frank was... Frank was playing, but I had quit. Yeah. Frank had quit, like Bruce, he said. You heard Bruce, but Bruce had... Bruce was... was... was playing... just about getting good, then, when I... Yeah. When I done quit, yeah.
It'll be by 1920, would you say? 1920 or the early 1920s?
